text:
Evan S.: Quick T&E question from last week's customer visit in Lisbon. Rented a car via local agency and upgraded to a compact SUV at the counter (+EUR 45). Paid Euros in cash for tolls and a small parking fine (EUR 25). Also my phone bill shows an unexpected international data roaming charge for EUR 12.
Evan S.: Questions: 1) Is counter upgrades reimbursable if not pre-approved? 2) Are tolls and parking fines reimbursable? 3) Re roaming: company policy on mobile data while abroad? 4) I paid some items in cash, do I need special receipts?
travel-bot: Reminder: upload itemized rental agreement, upgrade receipt or agent note, toll receipts if available, parking fine ticket, and carrier bill screenshot. Max 10MB per file.
People Ops (Maya): Short answers: 1) Counter upgrades are reimbursable ONLY if necessary for business reasons (e.g., luggage, team of 3, safety) or pre-approved. Spontaneous comfort upgrades are out-of-policy.
People Ops (Maya): 2) Tolls and parking fees are reimbursable with receipts. Fines/penalties (parking tickets, traffic fines) are generally NOT reimbursable unless they were incurred due to company-directed travel or unsafe conditions; provide a note explaining circumstances.
People Ops (Maya): 3) Mobile roaming: Redwood covers essential business data for approved travel only. If you used personal roaming for business and cost was minimal, we consider case-by-case. For recurring or >$50 charges, get pre-approval or request a temporary company SIM or roaming add-on.
Finance Team: Process steps: submit each charge as its own expense line in the portal. Use original currency and attach photos of all receipts. For cash tolls where no receipt is available, provide a short timeline note and manager attestation.
Finance Team: Expense portal template (copy/paste):
```
expense_type: rental_upgrade
amount: 45.00
currency: EUR
merchant: Lisbon Rent-a-Car / agent note
date: 2026-04-08
payment_method: personal_cash
attachments: rental_agreement.jpg, upgrade_receipt.jpg
note: compact->SUV upgrade at counter due to equipment load; manager_approval: pending.
```
Finance Team: For tolls/parking: set expense_type to tolls or parking and attach any barrier receipts or photo of ticket. For fines, expense_type: fine_exception and include manager sign-off in attachments.
Evan S.: I didn't get a receipt for one toll, just a photo of the barrier and a note from the rental agency that tolls were paid in cash. Manager Luca was with me and can confirm.
Manager (Luca): Confirm I approved the upgrade verbally on site due to demo hardware. I'll add a quick email now and attach.
Finance Team: For roaming, submit the carrier bill screenshot and indicate business_reason. Small one-off charges < EUR 20 usually approved if tied to business tasks; we'll flag anything higher for Preapproval check.
Evan S.: Any special handling if cash was split between company card and personal? I used cash then swiped the company card for fuel later at same station.
People Ops (Maya): Split payments are fine. Create two expense lines (cash and company_card) and attach station receipt or photo plus a note: "split payment - cash toll + company card fuel." Finance will net appropriately.
Ops-Bot: Note: if rental vendor is in our preferred vendor list, we can expedite reimbursement. Check vendor_id: RR-PORTO in notes.
Evan S.: Thanks, uploading rental agreement, upgrade note, barrier photo, carrier bill, and Luca's approval email now. Appreciated! :thumbsup:
